status_definitions.PRODUCTION_ACTIVE: Current daemon wiring and current runtime artifact exist.
status_definitions.PRODUCTION_DEGRADED: Current path executes but an observed defect or readiness gate remains.
status_definitions.CODE_READY_RELOAD_PENDING: Focused tests pass but the live process predates the change.
status_definitions.TESTED_NOT_WIRED: Implementation has regression evidence but is absent from the current production call path.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: Code exists but current production use and sufficient regression evidence were not established.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL_RUNTIME: A historical runtime artifact exists but no current process or current-run trace exists.
status_definitions.DESIGN_ONLY: Only design, declaration, or unexecuted contract evidence was established.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Implementation exists but a required production gate is not ready.
status_definitions.DISABLED: The current configuration intentionally disables the side effect.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED_OR_DUPLICATE: A byte-identical or functionally superseded implementation exists outside the proposed owner.
status_definitions.SENSITIVE_EXCLUDED: The repository or capability is intentionally excluded from ordinary discovery and model context.
